Ambessa.reason: Passive enhances next attack after ability use, creating a cast-auto loop that synergizes with Sheen items.

Annie.reason: Primary damage comes from abilities (Q, W, R); autos are filler and not mechanistically enhanced.

Diana.reason: Passive grants attack speed and bonus damage on third hit after casting abilities, encouraging ability-auto weaving.

Graves.reason: Sustained damage relies on basic attacks (shotgun autos with reload mechanic); abilities are utility or burst.

Gwen.reason: Abilities (Q, R) explicitly apply her on-hit passive, making on-hit items like Nashor's Tooth core.

Hecarim.reason: E empowers next auto after cast, and Q/W are frequently weaved with autos, making Sheen items effective.

Lucian.reason: Passive fires two shots after each ability, perfectly fitting the cast-auto rhythm for Sheen procs.

Lulu.reason: Damage is dealt through abilities (Q, Pix's bolts) and supporting allies; autos are negligible in damage.

Malphite.reason: Abilities (Q, W, E, R) deal primary damage; autos are filler.

Pantheon.reason: Comet Spear, Shield Vault, and Aegis Assault deliver damage; autos are supplementary.

Sett.reason: Passive and Q empower autos, encouraging ability-auto weave with Sheen synergy.

Soraka.reason: Starcall and Equinox are main damage; autos are negligible.

Viego.reason: Damage relies on auto attacks enhanced by Q passive and on-hit builds.

Xin Zhao.reason: Passive and Q empower autos; abilities are gap closers or steroids.

Zed.reason: Razor Shuriken, Shadow Slash, and Death Mark are primary damage sources.

Ziggs.reason: Bouncing Bomb, Satchel Charge, and Mega Inferno Bomb deliver burst; autos are filler.
